hooks.command: input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$file" | grep -q 'project\.godot$'; then echo 'BLOCK: Use Edit or mcp__godot-mcp__project_set_setting instead of overwriting project.godot' >&2; exit 1; fi

input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); if echo "$file" | grep -q '\.gd$'; then echo "[Hook] Validating GDScript changes..."; godot --headless --path . --quit || exit 1; fi
